title: Daily Delivery Row
description: Delivery for one day: spend, impressions, conversions, conversion value, and return on ad spend.

date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the reporting timezone: reporting_period.timezone when present, otherwise this package's product reporting_capabilities.timezone. The row covers that local day, which can be 23 or 25 hours long across a DST change.

conversion_value.description: Daily conversion value for this package

commissionable_value.description: Daily settled conversion value eligible for revenue-share commission for this package

roas.description: Daily return on ad spend (conversion_value / spend)

new_to_brand_rate.description: Daily fraction of conversions from first-time brand buyers (0 = none, 1 = all)
